help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or get in touch with us.

howItWorks.question: How does NordWash work?
howItWorks.answer: NordWash connects you with local washers who pick up your laundry, clean it professionally, and deliver it back to you. Simply create an order, choose your services, and we'll handle the rest.

pricing.question: What are the pricing options?
pricing.answer: We offer competitive per-item pricing for all services including wash & fold, dry cleaning, ironing, and more. Check our Services & Pricing section for detailed rates.

turnaround.question: How long does it take?
turnaround.answer: Standard turnaround is 24-48 hours. Express service is available for same-day delivery at an additional charge.

insurance.question: Is my laundry insured?
insurance.answer: Yes, all items are insured during the wash process. We take full responsibility for your clothes from pickup to delivery.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards and digital payments through our secure Stripe integration. Payment is processed after your order is complete.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel my order?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel your order for free before the washer picks up your laundry. After pickup, cancellation fees may apply.

infoCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
infoCollect.intro: NordWash collects information you provide directly to us, including:
items: Account information (name, email address, phone number)
Pickup and delivery addresses
Payment information (processed securely through Stripe)
Order history and preferences
Communications with our team or washers

howUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Process and fulfill your laundry orders
Communicate with you about your orders
Send you service updates and promotional offers
Improve our services and user experience
Ensure the security of our platform

infoSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
infoSharing.intro: We share your information only as necessary to provide our services:
items: With washers to fulfill your orders (pickup address and order details)
With payment processors to complete transactions
When required by law or to protect our rights
infoSharing.noSell: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

yourRights.title: 5. Your Rights
items: Access your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data
Opt-out of marketing communications

contact.title: 6. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the Help section of our app.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using NordWash, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

description.title: 2. Description of Service
description.content: NordWash is a platform that connects customers with laundry service providers (washers). We facilitate the pickup, cleaning, and delivery of laundry items.

userAccounts.title: 3. User Accounts
userAccounts.content: To use our services, you must create an account with accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.

ordersPayments.title: 4. Orders and Payments
items: All prices are displayed in the app and may be subject to change
Payment is processed securely through our payment provider
You agree to pay for all orders placed through your account
Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis

liability.title: 5. Liability
liability.content: While we take care to ensure quality service, NordWash is not liable for damages to items that are inherently delicate or improperly labeled. We recommend declaring any special care requirements when placing orders.

userConduct.title: 6. User Conduct
userConduct.content: You agree to use our services respectfully and lawfully. Abuse of the platform, including harassment of washers or fraudulent activity, may result in account termination.

changesToTerms.title: 7. Changes to Terms
changesToTerms.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For questions regarding these Terms of Service, please contact us through the Help section of our app.
